title: Procedure Identification
notes: Group 1 is fully cross-TAPP. The module owns field names, descriptions, tiers and data types. Each consuming TAPP supplies its own examples (F), comments (G), last-update dates (H) and mode flags, which the module cannot know. Migrated into all 14 production TAPPs on 2026-08-08; the former tapp_files/Template TAPP Group 1.csv is superseded and retained for reference only. Descriptions were reconciled first — in several fields the better text came from a TAPP rather than from the template, so the two are not interchangeable.
decisions: Column I (Keyed By) added to every field 2026-08-11 under Rule 7; owned_columns gained "I". Module-owned, so the value is authoritative for all consumers.
2026-08-12: added `Session Identifier` (Decision Record A6) — the analysis record is the session, which may cover several samples
